confirmed_facts.finding: The official Playwright run reached the generated application and reported exactly two failures: REQ-10.2 timed out after 10000ms and REQ-11.1 failed during locator.fill; REQ-12.1 passed.
REQ-10.2 waited for getByRole('button', { name: /alphabetical|name/i }).first() and timed out at helpers.ts:67.

The final template source renders the sort control as select#sort-by with option 'Alphabetical (A-Z)' and an Apply button; it does not emit a button or link whose accessible name matches /alphabetical|name/i.
REQ-11.1 resolved getByLabel(/Comment/i).first() to section.comments[aria-label=Comments], then attempted fill on that non-editable section.
The final template source places section.comments[aria-label=Comments] before the textarea labelled Comment, while the textarea itself is editable as #page-comment.

The backend contains POST handlers for both /api/books/<id>/sort and /api/books/<id>/pages/<pageId>/comments, so the observed failures occur at the UI locator/interaction boundary before those actions can be validated.

chain: The test enters the sort flow.
The helper requests a button named Alphabetical or Name.
The generated page exposes a select/option instead of that button/link role.
The locator never resolves and the 10000ms test timeout fires before the sort POST can be exercised.
The page has both a region named Comments and a textarea labelled Comment.
The first accessible-label match is the non-editable section.
locator.fill fails before the comment POST can be exercised.

root_cause_assessment.finding: Generated UI control role/name contract does not match the official helper locator: select/option is emitted where the helper is waiting for a matching button/link.
root_cause_assessment.boundary: generated application UI markup and accessibility contract

root_cause_assessment.finding: Accessible-name collision causes getByLabel(/Comment/i).first() to select the Comments section rather than the editable textarea.

The two failures are likely generator contract failures in the evolution-mode UI implementation rather than missing backend capabilities, because both corresponding POST handlers are present and the failures occur before submission.
